# Currency Converter X

> A comprehensive real-time currency conversion platform supporting 170+ fiat currencies, cryptocurrencies, and precious metals with live exchange rates and forex data.

Currency Converter X provides instant currency conversion across major currency pairs (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, JPY, etc.) and alternative assets. The platform offers both web and mobile access with real-time quotes, charts, and multi-currency comparison tools for traders and currency converters.

## Key Topics

- USD (US Dollar)
- EUR (Euro)
- GBP (British Pound)
- JPY (Japanese Yen)
- Real-time exchange rates
- Forex rates
- Currency pairs
- Live quotes
- Cryptocurrency conversion
- Precious metals (Gold, Silver, Platinum)
- Exchange calculator
- Currency charts
- Multi-currency support
- MetaTrader 5 integration
- Mobile app
